Our highly skilled craftsmen are experienced in working with all types of materials, including bricklaying, gunning, casting, ramming, hand packing, pumping and applying fibrous products in slab, blanket and modular forms. Being at the forefront of refractory engineering, our quality control, quality assurance and health and safety are fundamental to our continued success and long-standing reputation.
